record.label: Fixed DFTHC Hamiltonian for active space X
record.statement: The benchmark is the fixed double-factorized tensor-hypercontraction (DFTHC) Hamiltonian for active space X of Compound I, with 63 electrons in 58 spatial orbitals.
record.boundary: The tensor factors are fixed before circuit optimization. The error bound applies to the energies of this Hamiltonian in the 63-electron sector.
